The honest answer is that there is no strong case for buying CREST now.

The brief shows a coin down 86% over 30 minutes and 91% from its 30-minute high, with the last 15 minutes at -75% and net sell flow of -29.5 SOL. Sellers (329) outnumber recent buyers (259), and sell SOL (106) far exceeds buy SOL (77). The first two minutes after graduation show a sell-to-buy ratio near 0.9, which is heavy early distribution, not accumulation.

The one mildly positive signal is the ORGANIC class: no airdrop dump, top-3 curve share at 5.4%, and a fairly broad buyer base of 603. Those suggest the coin wasn't engineered as a single-wallet exit. But a broad buyer base that is now net selling, in a coin that has already lost most of its value, describes exhaustion, not persistent demand. The bundle share of 43.5% on the curve also warrants suspicion of coordinated buying.

Nothing in the brief says real demand is here and will still be here in 30 to 60 minutes. Base rates for coins in this state favor further loss. The scout's recommendation is to skip.
